survey: A single carved jack-o'-lantern sits on wooden floorboards against a purple sunburst background, seen from the front and slightly above. The body is a squat, roughly round pumpkin with even vertical ribs that meet at the top and bottom. A short green stem rises from a small dip at the top centre and curves a little, like a real cut stem. The front has three carved openings: two triangular eyes and a wide zigzag mouth. Each opening shows a thin cut edge and a yellow glow from inside, which fits a candle-lit lantern. The bottom of the pumpkin flattens a little where it meets the boards, and its contact shadow falls back and to the right, so it rests on the surface instead of floating. The ribs on the left and right are balanced, and the carved face follows the curve of the body. There are no loose parts, extra features or added gadgets.
